\section[\texorpdfstring{\pa{ਸਿੱਖਣਾ} (sikkhṇā)}{ਸਿੱਖਣਾ (sikkhṇā)}]{\pa{ਸਿੱਖਣਾ} (sikkhṇā) — to learn}

\label{lesson:PA-C60-sikkhna}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Punjabi for to sing, then the Punjabi for to dance.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \pa{ਸਿੱਖਣਾ}}
\textbf{\pa{ਸਿੱਖਣਾ}} — \emph{sikkhṇā} — \textquotedblleft{}to learn\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\pa{ਸਿੱਖਣਾ}} (\emph{sikkhṇā}) is a tadbhava, a word inherited from Sanskrit and reshaped by sound change. It comes from \emph{śikṣate}, \textquotedblleft{}learns\textquotedblright{} (CDIAL 12430).
\end{cousinweb}

\textbf{\pa{ਲਿਆਉਣਾ}} — \emph{liāuṇā} — \textquotedblleft{}to bring\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
Where \textbf{\pa{ਲਿਆਉਣਾ}} (\emph{liāuṇā}) comes from is not settled: CDIAL has no entry for it. \end{cousinweb}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\pa{ਭੇਜਣਾ} (bhejṇā)}{ਭੇਜਣਾ (bhejṇā)}]{\pa{ਭੇਜਣਾ} (bhejṇā) — to send}

\label{lesson:PA-C60-bhejna}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Punjabi for to want, then the Punjabi for to bring.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \pa{ਭੇਜਣਾ}}
\textbf{\pa{ਭੇਜਣਾ}} — \emph{bhejṇā} — \textquotedblleft{}to send\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\pa{ਭੇਜਣਾ}} (\emph{bhejṇā}) is a tadbhava, a word inherited and reshaped by sound change. It comes from \emph{*bhejj}, \textquotedblleft{}send\textquotedblright{}, a form CDIAL reconstructs from its descendants (CDIAL 9603). Its deeper source is uncertain: CDIAL suggests, with a \textquotedblleft{}possibly\textquotedblright{}, a Sanskrit verb meaning \textquotedblleft{}is led to\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}
